_comment: 關鍵事實表：每個事實都有原文引文（Lint W8 會驗證）。概念頁 frontmatter 的 facts 必須與這裡一致，用來偵測跨頁矛盾。misconceptions 是常見誤解，只能出現在『常見誤解』段落。

kerckhoffs.year.quote: This list of requirements was articulated in 1883

caesar.julius_key.quote: According to folklore, Julius Caesar used the key k = 3.

substitution.key_count_english.quote: If the alphabet is the English alphabet as in Example 1.25, then the size of the key space is 26!

aes.block_bits.quote: The AES algorithm is capable of using cryptographic keys of 128, 192, and 256 bits to encrypt and decrypt data in blocks of 128 bits.

aes.key_bits.quote: The AES algorithm is capable of using cryptographic keys of 128, 192, and 256 bits

aes.rounds.quote: AES-128(in , key) = CIPHER(in, 10, KEYEXPANSION(key)) AES-192(in, key) = CIPHER(in, 12, KEYEXPANSION(key)) AES-256(in, key) = CIPHER(in, 14, KEYEXPANSION(key))

aes.selected_year.quote: In 2000, NIST announced the selection of the Rijndael block cipher family as the winner

aes.example_key.quote: Key = 2b 7e 15 16 28 ae d2 a6 ab f7 15 88 09 cf 4f 3c

des.withdrawn_year.quote: DES was withdrawn as an approved algorithm in 2005

modes.sp800_38a.quote: Electronic Codebook (ECB), Cipher Block Chaining (CBC), Cipher Feedback (CFB), Output Feedback (OFB), and Counter (CTR)

gcm.block_bits.quote: GCM is constructed from an approved symmetric key block cipher with a block size of 128 bits

rsa.paper_recommended_digits.quote: We recommend using 100-digit (decimal) prime numbers p and q, so that n has 200 digits.

tls13.static_rsa_removed.quote: Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed

tls13.mandatory_suite.quote: A TLS-compliant application MUST implement the TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 [GCM] cipher suite

misconceptions.pattern: 加密(就|即|便)(能|可|會)?(保證|確保|提供).{0,8}(完整性|不可否認)
misconceptions.explain: 加密主要提供機密性；完整性與不可否認性需要其他工具（雜湊、MAC、數位簽章）。

misconceptions.pattern: (演算法|algorithm)(必須|應該|要)(保密|保持秘密)
misconceptions.explain: Kerckhoffs 原則：演算法可公開，安全性只建立在金鑰上。
AES 三個版本的區塊大小都是 128 位元；192/256 是金鑰長度。

misconceptions.pattern: DES.{0,10}(仍是|仍然是|依然是|目前是|現在是).{0,8}標準
misconceptions.explain: DES 已於 2005 年撤銷核准（SP 800-175B）。

misconceptions.pattern: ECB[^不非]{0,12}(很|最|足夠|相當|是)安全
misconceptions.explain: ECB 會讓相同明文區塊產生相同密文區塊，洩漏圖樣（SP 800-38A §6.1）。
SP 800-38A：IV 不需要保密，但 CBC 的 IV 必須無法預測。

misconceptions.pattern: (TLS ?1\.3|HTTPS)[^不非]{0,25}RSA[^不非]{0,15}(加密|傳送|傳輸)[^不非]{0,10}(session key|金鑰)
misconceptions.explain: TLS 1.3 已移除靜態 RSA 金鑰傳輸（RFC 8446 §1.2），RSA 只用於簽章。
